specific_changes: Introduction of Eleven v3 (alpha), the most expressive Text to Speech model
Deepak Chopra bringing his voice and teachings to life with ElevenLabs and Supertab
Launch of 11.ai (alpha), a voice assistant built to explore the potential of ElevenLabs Conversational AI technology
Introduction of the ElevenLabs app for iOS and Android
Partnership with Cisco to bring voice-first, agentic customer support to the enterprise
Partnership with PERSO.ai to bring natural voiceovers and frame-accurate lip-sync to global video localization
Strategic partnership with KPN to explore and deploy next-generation voice AI experiences
